title: Route a food bank's deliveries
heading: A Flow Model Has One Balance Row per Node: What Comes In, Less What Goes Out
cases: the cheapest shipments deliver every pantry's demand
a warehouse may keep stock no pantry needs, so supply is an upper limit
no route carries more than its capacity
a node that neither supplies nor demands sends out exactly what it receives
